name: gnome-global-menu
description: macOS-style global menu for GNOME Shell

scripts.install-ext: npm run build && D=~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-global-menu@felipefelix && rm -rf $D && mkdir -p $D && cp -r build/. $D/
scripts.pack: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack build --force --extra-source=menuModel.js --extra-source=menuBar.js --extra-source=registrar.js --extra-source=util.js --extra-source=sources
